bugs.error_message: Canvas2D: Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true.
bugs.root_cause: ctx() called canvas.getContext('2d') without options, so Chrome used a GPU-backed pipeline. The markup canvas snapshots itself via getImageData at the start of every drag (rect/arrow/blur preview), triggering the readback hint.
bugs.fix: Changed ctx() to canvas.value?.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }). The option only takes effect on the FIRST getContext call for a given canvas, so ctx() must remain the single accessor.

bugs.root_cause: tsconfig has "types": ["chrome", "vite/client"] but `vite` is not a declared dependency of @pinlay/extension (it's only transitive via WXT) and pnpm's isolated node_modules does not hoist it, so vue-tsc cannot resolve vite/client and aborts before checking any source. Pre-existing; not caused by the anchor change.
bugs.fix: Run `wxt prepare` to generate .wxt types first (needed regardless). Then either (a) add "vite" to extension devDependencies so vite/client resolves, or (b) drop "vite/client" from the tsconfig `types` array and rely on WXT's generated .wxt/wxt.d.ts. Workaround used for verification: isolated `tsc --skipLibCheck --lib dom,...` on the single file. `wxt build` is unaffected (esbuild strips types).

bugs.error_message: CRITICAL auth bypass: GET /api/auth/me with NO token returned 200 + owner data. Anyone could read/write the API unauthenticated if DEV_USER_EMAIL was set.
bugs.root_cause: JwtAuthGuard dev fallback resolved any tokenless request to DEV_USER_EMAIL as owner, with NO NODE_ENV guard. DEV_USER_EMAIL ships in .env.example, so one careless prod env copy = fully open API. Guard read process.env directly.
bugs.fix: Added validated config singleton src/config/env.ts. Dev-auth requires nodeEnv!=production AND ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true AND DEV_USER_EMAIL set. env() THROWS at boot if ALLOW_DEV_AUTH is on in production (process refuses to start). Guard reads env().devAuthEnabled. Verified: prod+ALLOW_DEV_AUTH refuses boot; prod without it -> devAuthEnabled=false even if DEV_USER_EMAIL leaks.

bugs.error_message: No rate limiting on /api/auth/login - 20 rapid wrong-password attempts all 401, never 429. Brute-force unthrottled.
bugs.root_cause: No @nestjs/throttler; no global or per-route rate limit.
bugs.fix: Installed @nestjs/throttler. Global ThrottlerGuard via APP_GUARD (100/min/IP). Tight @Throttle({ttl:60s,limit:5}) on login + signup. Verified: 6th rapid login -> 429.

bugs.error_message: Assignee/issue IDOR: createPin/updatePin accepted assigneeId or issueId from ANOTHER workspace with no membership check. Leaked cross-tenant user IDs onto pins.

bugs.fix: Added assertAssigneeInWorkspace() (assignee must be WorkspaceMember of caller ws -> 400) + assertIssueInWorkspace() (issue must belong to caller ws -> 404). Called in createPin + on reassign in updatePin. Verified: cross-ws assignee -> 400, foreign issueId -> 404, normal pin -> 201.

bugs.error_message: Pins dropped on one SPA route show as element not found on a different route, and new pins are saved under the previous route URL (reported on glown.io vs glown.io/search).
bugs.root_cause: The overlay detects SPA navigation by monkey-patching history.pushState/replaceState at overlay mount. But SPA routers (Nuxt/Vue Router/React Router) capture history.pushState at page load, before our patch installs, so their navigations call the saved original and bypass the patch; popstate/hashchange do not fire on pushState. livePageUrl stayed frozen at the mount-time URL, so existing pins from the old route rendered as element-not-found and new pins persisted with the stale pageUrl.
bugs.fix: Added a 500ms normalized-URL polling fallback (setInterval(onLocationMaybeChanged,500)) in onMounted, cleared in onBeforeUnmount, alongside the existing popstate/hashchange/patched-pushState listeners. Polling reliably catches every navigation style regardless of how the host SPA routes.

bugs.error_message: Dropping a pin takes a noticeable time after clicking Submit (the composer hangs in submitting state).
bugs.root_cause: onComposerSubmit awaited api.createPin and THEN ran a `for (const img of draft.images) await api.uploadAttachment(...)` loop serially, keeping the composer in submitting state until every attachment uploaded. With 1 screenshot this is 2 RTTs back-to-back; with N images it is N+1 serial RTTs.
bugs.fix: Close the composer + push the persisted pin as soon as createPin returns (the pin id is already known). Fire attachment uploads in parallel via Promise.all in the background; failures log a warning rather than blocking the dialog.

bugs.error_message: Markdown toolbar buttons (Bold/Italic/Link) in the pin composer render with default browser button chrome (gray bevel) instead of the intended icon-button style.
bugs.root_cause: The .pl-md-btn scoped CSS class set display/size/color but did not reset native <button> defaults (background, border, padding). Browsers paint their default button chrome under the icons, masking the intended look. Also violates the project rule against hand-written component CSS.
bugs.fix: Replaced .pl-md-btn with explicit Tailwind utility classes including the missing button resets (border-0, bg-transparent, p-0, cursor-pointer). Removed the scoped <style> block. Also added @mousedown.prevent so clicking the toolbar does not steal focus from the textarea (otherwise execCommand fails).

bugs.error_message: Cmd/Ctrl+Z in the pin composer description textarea does not undo changes made via the Bold/Italic/Link toolbar buttons.
bugs.root_cause: wrapSelection() and confirmLink() mutated description.value directly. A direct v-model mutation bypasses the textarea native edit pipeline, so the change is never added to the browser undo stack — Cmd+Z then jumps over the toolbar action.
bugs.fix: Route the replacement through document.execCommand("insertText", false, replacement) after focusing the textarea and setSelectionRange(). execCommand goes through the native edit pipeline so the change IS undoable. Keep a direct-mutation fallback for older engines/unfocused state.
